scenario.note: The limit on the number of mines that may be operated per year is removed for Year1 and Year5.
The maximum number of mines that may be operated per year is removed only for Year1 and Year5, while remaining in force for other years.
The limits on the number of mines that can operate per year and the blend quality target are removed, allowing any number of mines to operate and any blend grade to be produced.

The limit on the number of mines that may operate per year is lifted by setting max_mines to 0 (unbounded). The blend-quality target is removed by setting quality_target to 0, which effectively relaxes the quality constraint.
The stay-closed rule is relaxed for Year4, allowing a mine to reopen after being closed in that year.
The stay-closed rule is relaxed for Year4, allowing a closed mine to reopen in that year.
